findings.title: Replay/idempotency key was regenerated per attempt (fixed)
findings.note: Key created once and reused on retry.

findings.title: Webhook delivery follows redirects / does not pin the validated IP (SSRF)
findings.note: Same root cause as SEC SSRF finding; owned here for the delivery path.
evidence: delivery fetch has no redirect/DNS-pin guard
findings.impact: Validated public URL can redirect to internal services.
findings.recommendation: redirect:'manual' + IP-pinned dispatch with per-hop re-validation.

report:
Replay/idempotency/durability
walk of the webhook pipeline. Delivery is durable and idempotent; the SSRF
redirect gap is carried here as the webhook-domain owner.
